decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate heat exchangers for HVAC are close to the core portfolio and serve steady HVAC and heat-pump demand, which strengthened after 2021, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The marine box cooler line holds a major market share in water cooling and generates recurring service business, making it a strong product to retain.
The marine cooling unit complements the box cooler line in the marine segment, though as a single product it could be folded into the broader range, so the drop risk is slightly higher.
Compact oil coolers build on established competence and serve recurring industrial and transportation demand, so they remain worth keeping.
Finned tubes are a core component for the firm's air coolers and its own exchanger production, so the firm has little reason to drop them.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes reflect the firm's R&D strength and its efficiency promise, which supports retaining them amid rising energy-efficiency demand.
